metadata.title: Build an independent inference engine

applicability.scope: Independent runtime bring-up across OS, model format, device and backend boundaries.
applicability.input_contract: Actual hardware, model, engine, script and flags, benchmark, acceptance criteria, current diagnosis, permitted changes and budget.
applicability.produced_artifact: Operator/capability map, minimal native execution path, end-to-end parity and resource measurements.
applicability.refusal_point: Record missing evidence or an exhausted search budget and identify the smallest discriminating test before declaring success.

limitations: The cards describe routes and acceptance evidence; hardware support and task success require separate validation.

body.json.text:
{
  "task": "independent-engine",
  "title": "Build an independent inference engine",
  "choose_when": "A new runtime must own execution, memory and device integration on a distinct OS, model or hardware stack.",
  "required_inputs": [
    "target OS and device",
    "runtime API and driver/toolchain availability",
    "model format and memory budget",
    "reference inputs and expected outputs"
  ],
  "steps": [
    "Prove model loading and one operation on the target device.",
    "Complete one end-to-end output, including fallback and lifecycle checks.",
    "Measure resident memory, correctness and cold/warm behavior on the actual OS and hardware."
  ],
  "acceptance_evidence": "An independently runnable target-native engine, adapter boundaries and target-device validation results.",
  "candidate_skill_ids": [
    "mlc-llm",
    "local-dream",
    "audit-llama-runtime-state",
    "os-process-placement",
    "inference-benchmark-design"
  ]
}
